analysis.title: Palo Alto Networks 1Q27 Preview: High expectations as usual, but recent pullback should help
key_insights: BofA reiterates Buy and $420 PO on PANW (price $326.36). 1Q27 results are scheduled for 11/18 after market close.

Stock is down 25% from its October highs, which lowers expectations somewhat. Valuation is still 18x CY27 EV/Sales vs a peer median of 7x, so BofA says a strong ~3% beat and raise is likely needed for a positive reaction.
Before the 4Q26 print the stock had risen over 140% in the prior 6 months, and it fell 9% the following trading day.
BofA models Next-Gen Security (NGS) ARR at $9.55B, up 63% y/y, implying $450mn of net new NGS ARR, up 68% y/y. Consensus 2Q NGS ARR is $9.9B, up 57% y/y. Investors likely want a 3%+ beat on both.
1Q revenue is expected at $3.3B, up 34% y/y. Product revenue consensus is $542mn, up 25%. RPO is expected at $20.9B, up 35% y/y, vs $21.2B, up 34% y/y last quarter.
Gross margin is a watch item. BofA models 1Q27 gross margin at 74.6%, down 230bps y/y, on higher cloud and component costs.
Security for AI and Prisma AIRS will be watched closely. It last reached $120mn ARR and 800 customers.

Firewall read-throughs are mixed. PANW firewall bookings rose 17% y/y in FY26, helped by new cloud builds, refresh cycles and AI traffic add-ons. Fortinet and Check Point results show a slowdown after a strong 1H26. BofA believes PANW is taking share and benefiting from a refresh cycle spread over several quarters.
On M&A, BofA looks for continued positive updates on the CyberArk and Chronosphere integrations and clarity on the widely reported ~$500mn Clutch acquisition for non-human identity.

BofA's PO of $420 is based on about 19x CY27E EV/Sales, above appliance peers at 6-8x. Successful SaaS vendors trade at 13-19x forward revenue. Risks are competition and execution during the move to cloud and SASE.

market_movers.rationale: BofA calls PANW a clear leader in security platform consolidation in the age of AI and looks through volatility around the print. Valuation at 18x CY27 EV/Sales requires a beat and raise.

sector_views.rationale: Platformization deals show solid growth and strong net revenue retention, and FCF is expected to step up over the next few years.

earnings_insights: PANW 1Q27 (FY ends July) reports 11/18 after market close. BofA estimates: revenue $3,305mn (+33.6% y/y), non-GAAP EPS $0.97, non-GAAP gross margin 74.4%, non-GAAP operating margin 29.3%. These are BofA estimates, not reported figures.
Consensus (per BofA exhibit) for 1Q27: revenue $3,305.9mn (+34% y/y), NGS ARR $9,467mn (+62% y/y), RPO $20,860mn. BofA's estimates are roughly in line with the Street.
BofA 2Q27 estimates: revenue $3,437mn (+32.5% y/y), non-GAAP EPS $1.03, NGS ARR $9,900mn, billings $3,632mn. Consensus 2Q27 revenue $3,418mn, NGS ARR $9,918mn.

FY27 (July) BofA estimates: revenue $14,151mn (+23.3%), non-GAAP EPS $4.18 (consensus per Bloomberg and Visible Alpha $4.18), FCF $5,379mn, FCF margin 38.0%. FY28 EPS estimate $4.95 vs Bloomberg consensus $4.87.
Last reported quarter 4Q26: revenue $3,410mn, NGS ARR $9,100mn (+63% y/y), net new NGS ARR $970mn, billings $4,561mn (+23% y/y), RPO $21.2B. FY26 revenue was $11,480mn (+24.5%), non-GAAP EPS $3.83.
Quarterly non-GAAP EPS: FY26 Q1 $0.93A, Q2 $1.03A, Q3 $0.85A, Q4 $1.03A. BofA estimates for FY27 are Q1 $0.97, Q2 $1.03, Q3 $1.02, Q4 $1.16.
risk_factors: Valuation of 18x CY27 EV/Sales vs peer median 7x leaves little room for a miss and likely requires a ~3% beat and raise.
Gross margin pressure from higher cloud and component costs.
Slowing firewall demand signals at Fortinet and Check Point.
Competition and execution challenges during the transition to cloud and SASE models.
vol_and_positioning: PANW fell 9% the trading day after its 4Q26 print after rising over 140% in the prior 6 months. The stock is now 25% below its October highs, with a 52-week range of $139.57 to $432.33.

tension_points.bull_case: BofA sees PANW as a clear leader in security platform consolidation in the age of AI, taking share with platform sales and a firewall refresh spread over several quarters. The 25% pullback lowers expectations somewhat.
tension_points.bear_case: Valuation of 18x CY27 EV/S vs a 7x peer median likely requires a ~3% beat and raise for a positive reaction. Fortinet and Check Point show slowdowns and gross margin faces pressure.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A print that fails to beat NGS ARR by about 3% or lacks a raise would leave the stock without a positive reaction, per BofA's framing.
